set.body: Follow-up to landed P1 97f53a2. m1 independently confirmed the production fix and all changed measurements, then found a narrower failure-shield gap: AnnaFixtureSuite computes expected lemmas through the same Lexical.stems call used to build the fixture. If the production stemmer regresses to identity, both sides move together and the parity test stays green, returning the fixture to raw lemmas. Add a concrete non-self-referential normalized-output assertion (for example isolated -> isol) and make the private helper name state that it accepts raw terms only, because Porter stemming is not generally idempotent. Prove the old law survives an identity-stemmer mutation while the new law fails. Final source scope is only AnnaFixture.scala and AnnaFixtureSuite.scala; lexical.scala may be temporarily reserved for disposable mutation proof but must not appear in the candidate. Candidate SHA, exact scope gates, independent review, and chief ACK still required.
set.title: align tests: make AnnaFixture normalization guard non-vacuous
